description_en: Creates a collector to collect data from a specified service
description_zh: 创建采集器，采集指定服务上的数据
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch create-collector --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --dry-run false --name test_beats_1 --res-type fileBeat --vpc-id vpc-bp12nu14urf0upaf00000 --res-version 6.8.5_with_community --collector-paths /var/log --configs fileName=filebeat.yml content=filebeat.inputs:xxx --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCollector

parameters.description_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run without performing the actual request. This parameter is used only when you create or update a collector. Valid values:

- true: performs only a dry run without creating or updating the collector.
- false: performs a dry run and sends the request.
parameters.description_zh:
是否校验并创建采集器，只有在创建或更新采集器时使用此参数。可选值：

- true：只校验不更新
- false：校验并更新
